# Lab 3.2: Create a Cloud Identity Free Account & Organization

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a free Cloud Identity account on a domain you own, verify the domain, and see the Google Cloud organization appear automatically.

## Steps

1. **Get a domain.** You need a domain you control, for example `yourname-lab.com`. Any domain registrar works.

2. **Sign up for Cloud Identity Free.** Go to `https://workspace.google.com/gcpidentity/signup?sku=identitybasic`. Enter your business name, your email and the domain. Create the first admin user, for example `admin@yourname-lab.com`.

3. **Verify the domain.** The Admin console shows a TXT record. Add it at your registrar's DNS settings, then click **Verify**. DNS changes can take a few minutes.

4. **Sign in to the Google Cloud console** as `admin@yourname-lab.com`. Accept the terms.

5. **See the organization.** Click the project picker and choose **All**. A node with your domain name appears at the top. This is the **organization**, created automatically once the domain is verified.

6. **Grant yourself organization roles.** Go to **IAM & Admin → IAM** with the organization selected. Check that the admin user has **Organization Administrator**. Add **Folder Admin**, **Organization Policy Administrator** and **Security Center Admin** to the same user, because later labs need them.

7. **Move your lab project.** If `pcse-labs` was created under the trial account, create a new project `pcse-labs-org` under the organization instead and link it to your billing account.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Cloud Identity Free | No cost, up to 50 users by default |
| Organization | Created automatically after domain verification |
| Org name | Same as your domain |
| Admin user | Has Organization Administrator |
